about: Riverview is a town in southeastern New Brunswick, across the Petitcodiac River from Moncton and forming part of the Greater Moncton area. Residential neighbourhoods and parks climb the hillside above the tidal river, with shopping and services shared across the tri-community of Moncton, Dieppe, and Riverview. About 20,000 people live in Riverview.
